subject: Approval request: end-of-quarter micro-grant for HyperMetric POC
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval request: end-of-quarter micro-grant for HyperMetric POC

Team —

Quick ask for an EOQ close push on HyperMetric (POC live, exec buy-in, contract expected this month). They hit token limits on the trial and asked for a small credit + 30-day extension to prove a scale scenario for their data pipeline. Proposed motion: provide a $7,500 usage credit and 30-day trial extension. Goal: convert to Dedicated during Q3; expected ARR uplift ~ $120k ARR in year 1 if we get them to commit.

Why now:
- Exec sponsor confirmed timeline to vote next week
- They need predictable latency for a 1M token/day test next month

Ask: Marissa — approval to commit $7.5k credit (applies to hosted usage only) with the 30-day extension. Sean — please confirm tracking code/HubSpot annotation and whether we need a SOC-2 addendum. Monica — CS will run the extended POC. If approved, I’ll send amendment to Heather and loop legal.

Attachments: pricing-sheet.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0147

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval request: end-of-quarter micro-grant for HyperMetric POC

Ben —

I support this. Approve the $7,500 micro-grant + 30d extension with two caveats: 1) credit expires if there is no signed MSA or PO within 45 days of grant, and 2) include the standard conversion uplift clause (we want to protect pricing if they move to Dedicated). Please route the formal amendment through Sean for recording against the HM-2027-Q4 opportunity.

Cc'ing Finance/RevOps for tracking. Marissa

Marissa Cole | Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Approval request: end-of-quarter micro-grant for HyperMetric POC

All —

I can take this and log it in RevOps. A couple notes from ops/finance:
- Please mark the credit type as "Promotional micro-grant" and allocate to Q2 marketing allowance (budget owner: Marissa Cole).
- Credit expiration per Marissa: 45 days. I will add the conversion uplift clause to the amendment.
- I pushed an update to HubSpot (deal HM-2027-Q4) and added an internal note: "7.5k credit/30d extension approved 2027-06-18". Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/98765

I've drafted an amendment (PDF stub) and uploaded to Box. Ben — please confirm the exact credit amount in writing to the customer and attach the amendment for signature.

Attachment: hm-poc-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher | RevOps Manager
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Heather Lin <heather@hypermetric.ai>
Cc: legal@hypermetric.ai, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Offer: $7,500 usage credit + 30-day extension — HyperMetric POC (HM-2027-Q4)

Heather —

Nice talking earlier. Per our discussion and internal approvals, Redwood can offer a one-time $7,500 usage credit (hosted API usage only) and a 30-day trial extension to run your scale test. Key points:
- Credit: $7,500 applied to account billing; any overage beyond credit billed at standard rates.
- Term: credit must be used within 45 days of issuance; if no signed MSA/PO within 45 days, credit will be rescinded.
- Conversion uplift: if you convert to Dedicated, standard onboarding uplift applies as described in the amendment.

I've attached the amendment for signature (hm-poc-amendment-draft.pdf). If that looks good, Legal can countersign; otherwise send any edits to legal@hypermetric.ai and I will route.

Next steps I propose:
1) You sign the amendment (Doc sent via Box/DocuSign)
2) Monica (cc'd) will schedule a 90-minute technical runbook session for next week so we can validate the 1M token/day test case
3) I will provision the credit once DocuSign is complete and confirm with Sean for bookkeeping

Attachment: hm-poc-amendment-draft.pdf (PDF, 3 pages)

Thanks,
Ben Carter | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
